name: UNDP Human Development Index 2022
aggregation_form: geometric mean of three sub-indices, education being the mean of the two schooling indicators - not a weighted sum
source: UNDP Human Development Report 2023-24 composite indices, https://hdr.undp.org/sites/default/files/2023-24_HDR/HDR23-24_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv
note: HDI declares three dimensions - a long and healthy life, knowledge, and a decent standard of living - built from four indicators. The two schooling indicators belong to one declared dimension, so four columns against three claimed dimensions is the documented design and not itself a finding.
